description: Illustrative inference scenarios, not measured rates for these proprietary model names or statistical confidence bounds. Energy includes serving infrastructure once; known token overlaps are normalized; Antigravity input/cache separation is an explicit assumption.

sources.supports: Measured Gemini Apps median prompt energy, serving boundary and WUE method; NOT these token coefficients.
2024 LBNL US data center report: approximately 0.36 L/IT-kWh direct WUE and 4.52 L/facility-kWh electricity water in 2023. Historical US proxies, not actual provider regions.
Inference energy varies with throughput, power, overhead and test-time scaling; NOT exact rates for project models.
Input/output length, architecture, hardware and batching matter; NOT exact rates for project models.
